name: Chatwoot
summary: Open-source, AI-powered customer-support inbox with live chat and a managed cloud, plus Captain AI credits on paid plans.
description: Open-source, AI-powered customer-support inbox with live chat and a managed cloud, plus Captain AI credits on paid plans.

pricing.details: Cloud: Hacker 0 €/agent/month — up to 2 agents, 500 conversations/month, live chat only, Captain AI not included, 30-day data retention. Startups 17 €/agent/month — unlimited conversations, all channels (voice not included), Captain AI 300 credits, help center, 1-year data retention. Business 35 €/agent/month — unlimited conversations, all channels including voice, Captain AI 500 credits, help center, teams, automation rules, 2-year data retention. Enterprise 90 €/agent/month — everything in Business plus Captain AI 800 credits, SSO/SAML, audit logs, 3-year data retention. Additional Captain AI credits are billed at 18 € per 1,000. Self-hosted plans are also listed on the same official pricing page.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source, AI-powered customer-support inbox, self-hosted or on Chatwoot Cloud
Live chat and omnichannel inboxes; help center, teams, automation and voice on higher plans
Captain AI assistant with included credits on paid cloud plans, plus top-up packs
Hacker is free for up to 2 agents (live chat only); self-hosted plans are listed on the same official page
